images.madeBy: Alex Smith, for this bestax port
images.method: Drawn by code: docs/scripts/template-art/scenes/event-participation.mjs places every block and shape, and the voxel renderer in docs/scripts/template-art writes the SVG, with every texture generated from a palette and a seed. No photograph, stock image or other third-party image was used as an input or as a tracing reference.
images.depicts: A blocky gold medal with the number 50 in the pixel font standing proud of its face, inside a raised rim, with two small sparkles; the event's logo.
images.replaces: public/media/event_logo_gold.webp, the original's logo image, whose source the original does not record.
